title: Masquerade Ritual: Face & Mask Alignment
description: A sculpted human head (LeePerrySmith) floats in a dark ceremonial space while a Venetian mask hovers nearby. The user must perform a multi-step ritual: position, rotate, and scale the mask to perfectly align it onto the face, then adjust lighting and material properties to complete the transformation.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with ES modules from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load both GLB assets: LeePerrySmith.glb as a centered human head and venice_mask.glb as a floating mask. Scene setup: dark background (#0a0a12), a subtle fog, and a stone pedestal (cylinder geometry, dark gray) beneath the head. Camera: PerspectiveCamera at z=3, OrbitControls enabled but limited to prevent flipping. Lighting: one dim ambient light (0x222244) and one warm SpotLight (0xffcc88) from above casting shadows onto the pedestal. Both models should be normalized to similar scale on load using their bounding boxes. The mask starts offset to the right (x=1.5) and slightly rotated. Implement a GUI panel (lil-gui from CDN) with these interaction steps the user must perform: (1) A 'Mask X Position' slider (-2 to 2, default 1.5) to slide the mask horizontally toward the face. (2) A 'Mask Y Position' slider (-1 to 1, default 0.2) for vertical alignment. (3) A 'Mask Z Position' slider (-1 to 1, default 0.3) for depth alignment. (4) A 'Mask Rotation Y' slider (-45 to 45 degrees, default 15) to rotate the mask to face forward. (5) A 'Mask Scale' slider (0.5 to 1.5, default 0.8) to match the mask to the face size. (6) A 'Spotlight Intensity' slider (0 to 5, default 1.5) to illuminate the merged result. (7) A 'Mask Opacity' slider (0 to 1, default 0.85) — set the mask material to transparent and control opacity. (8) A 'Complete Ritual' button that validates alignment: mask X must be within ±0.15 of 0, Y within ±0.15 of 0, Z within ±0.15 of 0.05, rotation within ±10 of 0, and scale between 0.9 and 1.1. If valid, trigger a celebration: smoothly animate the spotlight color cycling through gold, crimson, and purple over 3 seconds, add a particle burst (200 small sphere geometries with random velocities fading out), and display an overlay text 'The Mask Is Bound' in elegant serif font. If invalid, flash the GUI panel border red briefly and show 'Alignment Incomplete' overlay text that fades after 2 seconds. Add a subtle idle animation: the head and mask both gently bob up and down with a sine wave (amplitude 0.03, different phases). Render with PCFSoftShadowMap enabled and tone mapping set to ACESFilmic.
